Training load

Log a session above and your training-load chart starts here.

Load = minutes × effort (1–10). The ratio compares this week's load with your average over the last four weeks. Between 0.8 and 1.3 is the safe zone; sudden spikes above 1.5 are when injuries tend to happen.
